In June 2026, compared with June 2025, industrial production increased by 0.1% in the euro area and by 0.6% in the EU.

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with May 2026, industrial production

Among the Member States for which data are available, the highest monthly increases were recorded in Denmark (+5.4%), Croatia (+5.2%), Lithuania and Finland (both +2.1%). The largest decreases were observed in Luxembourg (-10.7%), Portugal (-3.9%) and Estonia (-2.2%).

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with June 2025, industrial production

Among the Member States for which data are available, the highest annual increases were recorded in Lithuania (+7.7%), Denmark (+6.1%) and Poland (+4.9%). The largest decreases were observed in Luxembourg (-7.9%), Romania (-5.6%) and Estonia (-4.6%).

Compared with data issued in the News Release of 15 July 2026, the monthly percentage change for May 2026 has been revised from -0.2% to +0.3% in the euro area and from -0.1% to +0.3% in the EU. The annual percentage change has been revised from -1.2% to -0.1% in the euro area and from -0.3% to +0.6% in the EU .

The index of industrial production measures the evolution of the volume of production for industry excluding construction, based on data adjusted for calendar and seasonal effects.

Seasonally adjusted euro area and EU series are calculated by aggregating the seasonally adjusted national data.

Total industry covers NACE Rev. 2 sections B to D. Missing observations from Member States for recent months are estimated for the calculation of the euro area and the EU aggregates.

text:
In June 2026, compared with June 2025, the calendar adjusted retail sales index increased by 0.7% in the euro area and by 1.2% in the EU.

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with May 2026, the volume of retail trade

decreased for non-food products (except automotive fuel) by 0.4%,

increased for automotive fuel in specialised stores by 1.5%.

decreased for non-food products (except automotive fuel) by 0.3%,

increased for automotive fuel in specialised stores by 1.7%.

Among Member States for which data are available, the largest monthly decreases in the total retail trade volume were recorded in Finland (-1.5%), Romania (-1.2%) and Germany (-1.1%). The highest increases were observed in Luxembourg (+2.5%), Portugal (+1.7%), Croatia and Sweden (both +1.5%).

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with June 2025, the volume of retail trade

increased for non-food products (except automotive fuel) by 1.7%,

decreased for automotive fuel in specialised stores by 6.6%.

increased for non-food products (except automotive fuel) by 2.3%,

decreased for automotive fuel in specialised stores by 4.1%.

Among Member States for which data are available, the highest annual increases in the total retail trade volume were recorded in Luxembourg (+8.3%), Sweden (+7.2%) and Bulgaria (+7.1%). Decreases were observed in Romania (-6.6%), Austria (-0.3%), Belgium and Germany (both -0.1%).

Compared with the data issued in the News Release of 6 July 2026, the monthly percentage change for May 2026 has been revised from +0.2% to +0.4% in the euro area and from +0.5% to +0.6% in the EU. The annual percentage change has been revised from +1.6% to +1.9% in the euro area and from +1.9% to +2.1% in the EU.

The index of the volume of retail trade measures the evolution of the turnover in retail trade, adjusted for price changes (deflated), i.e. the evolution of the total amount of goods sold, based on data adjusted for calendar and seasonal effects.

text:
In June 2026, compared with June 2025, industrial producer prices increased by 4.6% in the euro area and by 4.7% in the EU.

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with May 2026, industrial producer prices

Prices in total industry excluding energy increased by 0.2%.

Prices in total industry excluding energy increased by 0.2%.

The largest monthly decreases in industrial producer prices were recorded in Lithuania (-1.7%), Ireland (-1.5%), Bulgaria and Greece (both -1.3%). The highest increases were observed in Slovakia (+1.1%), Romania (+1.0%) and Estonia (+0.9%).

In the euro area in June 2026, compared with June 2025, industrial producer prices

Prices in total industry excluding energy increased by 3.0%.

Prices in total industry excluding energy increased by 2.9%.

The highest annual increases in industrial producer prices were recorded in Bulgaria (+18.2%), Romania (+14.3%) and Ireland (+11.4%), while the only decrease was observed in Luxembourg (-3.2%).

Compared with data issued in the News Release of 6 July 2026, the monthly percentage increases for May 2026 remained unchanged at +0.2% in both the euro area and the EU. The annual percentage increases also remained unchanged at +5.9% in the euro area and at +5.7% in the EU.

The index of producer prices shows (in the national currency of the country concerned) changes in the ex-works sale prices of all products sold on the domestic market, excluding imports. Euro area and EU indices refer to overall weighted price changes. The figures are not calendar day or seasonally adjusted.

Total industry covers NACE rev.2 sections B to D + E36.
